name: Sovrium Intranet
description: A company hub — announcements, people, resources.

BASE_URL.description: Public URL of this app. The url generator gives each review app its own address instead of inheriting the parent app's.

NODE_ENV.description: Runtime mode. Matches the parent app.

SOVRIUM_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Master key for encrypting stored credentials at rest (AES-256-GCM). Review apps get their own key: their database starts empty, so there is nothing encrypted with the parent key to read.

TRUSTED_PROXY_HOPS.description: Number of reverse proxies in front of the app, so client IPs and the request scheme are read from the right X-Forwarded-* entry. Scalingo puts one hop in front of every app, review apps included.
